independent_technical_reasoning: GPU temperature, memory temperature and power delivery approach steady state over time, while intermittent errors may require sustained load. Twenty minutes and one hour therefore represent different fault-detection and safety envelopes. With no Procedure duration or Criteria, neither can be selected merely because one appears in the title or estimate field.
